'''Jim Colson''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 5 FL from Huntsville, Al. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

[[File:Jim Colson DecipherCon 2000.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Colson at DecipherCon 2000 (still from Brandon Baity's video)]]

He was one of the first Squadron Members, answering Decipher's call in 1996. For almost a year he was the only tournament director in a three-state area of Dagobah and Yavin 4, running monthly events in Huntsville, Birmingham and Nashville. He was also a Star Trek CCG Ambassador.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.

== Other sourced notes ==

Gold 5 FL, Huntsville, Alabama. RFD broadcast 10 discussed Star Trek CCG in the Alabama region with Jonathan Quesenberry.
